nodes.question: How can digitalization and new technologies help citizens and businesses be environmentally friendly, according to Bird and Krogstad (2020)?
nodes.answer: Digitalization and new technologies can make it easier for citizens and businesses to be environmentally friendly by reducing energy consumption, carbon footprint, and enabling more sustainable practices.
